description: Employees ask for days off and managers approve or reject the requests.
data: employees with full name, email (unique) and the number of leave days they get each year
leave requests of an employee with a start date, an end date, the number of days and a status (pending, approved, rejected or cancelled)
actions: managers approve or reject a request
employees see how many days an employee has used and has left
managers see all employees and all requests
rules: nobody can take more days than they have left
an employee's leave requests cannot overlap
leave cannot start in the past and cannot end before it starts
a request is decided once; approved or pending leave can still be cancelled
cancelled leave gives the days back
